name: Dozzle
description: Lightweight real-time Docker log viewer with a clean web interface. No log storage — live monitoring only.

env.label: Admin Username
env.description: Username for basic authentication (leave empty to disable auth)

env.label: Admin Password
env.description: Password for basic authentication (leave empty to disable auth)

env.label: Log Level
env.description: Application log level for Dozzle itself

env.label: Disable Analytics
env.description: Set to true to disable anonymous analytics

env.label: Container Filter
env.description: Docker container filter to limit which containers are shown (e.g., name=myapp)
